purpose: Teach: 実戦/石綿/快晴/歳児/ミドル/水上/境内/パース

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、武道の実戦稽古の歴史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you wrote your paper on the history of practical martial arts training, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Gentle confirmation — she's checking in, not testing. Slight lift at the end, inviting him to share more.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、石綿アスベスト被害の医学を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on the medical aspects of asbestos exposure.
lines.style: Direct but soft. A small pause before answering, like he's gathering his thoughts. Quiet confidence in his words, no defensiveness.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、快晴日数の気象研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, you covered weather research on clear-sky frequency patterns for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful tone, slightly curious. She's genuinely interested in the range of his interests. Gentle cadence, like she's piecing something together.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、三歳児健診の発達評価を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on developmental assessment in three-year health screenings.
lines.style: Patient delivery. He's used to being misunderstood about his topics. Calm accuracy — he's just correcting, not frustrated.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ミドルクラスの社会学を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You wrote about the sociology of the middle class for your paper, didn't you?
lines.style: Engaged and attentive. A slight warmth — she's following the thread of his interests closely. Clear, straightforward, no condescension.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、水上スポーツの安全研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on safety research in water sports.
lines.style: Steady rhythm. He's settling into the pattern now. Honest and precise, slightly matter-of-fact tone — he knows what he studied.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 蓮さん、神社境内の伝統儀礼を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Ren, your paper dealt with traditional rituals within shrine grounds, didn't it?
lines.style: Reflective, almost gently amused. She's testing something here — her tone suggests she's noticing his pattern of gentle corrections. Soft warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、コンピューターのパース処理を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote my paper on parsing processes in computer programming.
lines.style: Quiet, close. A small exhale at the end — almost resigned, almost affectionate. He's accepted that they keep missing each other, and there's something tender in that acceptance.
